Data Table ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Manage requests, pagination, and selection across pages using the base table's display features.

Basic usage ​

The example uses a local asynchronous function, an explicit pagination parameter builder, and a response transform for its row type. A page change requests the corresponding slice. The columns and toolbar use the same data as the table.

Example: basic

vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamBaseForm class="query-tools" @submit.prevent="query = { text: draft.trim() }">
			<AsamInput v-model="draft" aria-label="项目名称" placeholder="按项目名称查询" />
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="submit">查询</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" plain native-type="button" @click="resetQuery">
				重置
			</AsamButton>
		</AsamBaseForm>
		<AsamDataTable
			ref="table"
			:api="api"
			:query="query"
			:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
			:transform="transform"
			:row-key="rowKey"
			:page-size="2"
			:page-sizes="[2, 5]"
			selectable
			size="default"
			@selection-change="selection = $event"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" width="64" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="项目名称" min-width="120" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="status" label="状态" min-width="84" />
			<template #empty>没有匹配的项目</template>
			<template #toolbar="{ selection: selected, loading, stale }">
				<span>已选 {{ selected.keys.length }} 项</span>
				<AsamButton
					native-type="button"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:disabled="loading || stale"
					@click="table?.clearSelection()"
				>
					清空选择
				</AsamButton>
			</template>
		</AsamDataTable>
		<output>已选编号：{{ selection.keys.join('、') || '无' }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamInput, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamTableSelection
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableBasicDemoExample' });
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	status: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Params extends Query {
	currentPage: number;
	pageSize: number;
}

const draft = ref('');
const query = ref<Query>({ text: '' });
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const selection = ref<AsamTableSelection<Row>>({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const rows: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '研发知识库', status: '进行中' },
	{ id: 2, name: '客户工作台', status: '已完成' },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发门户', status: '待启动' },
	{ id: 4, name: '数据字典', status: '进行中' },
	{ id: 5, name: '园区巡检', status: '已暂停' },
	{ id: 6, name: '交付清单', status: '已完成' }
];
function resetQuery() {
	draft.value = '';
	query.value = { text: '' };
}
const rowKey = (row: Row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input: Query, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<Params, AsamPage<Row>> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (response: AsamPage<Row>) => response;
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-root-layout {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
	min-width: 0;
}
.query-tools {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;

	max-width: 100%;
}
.query-tools > * {
	max-width: 100%;
	margin-inline-start: 0;
}
.demo-root-layout > output {
	margin-block: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Request and pagination overrides ​

Choose one of api or request. The API branch requires buildPageParams. The URL branch supports buildPageRequest or pageTarget. See the full notes.

Selection, events, and instance methods ​

selection-change emits a cross-page { keys, rows } snapshot in place of the base table's row-array payload. See the full notes.

Full table instance and half-checked tree rows ​

The component forwards the full public instance of the current base table, including getHalfSelectionRows, columns, tableId, ns, layout, and store. Method calls retain the original receiver. Observed values update on mount and when the current table changes. Treat objects such as ns, layout, and store as read-only observations. Their internal methods fall outside the stable public API.

getHalfSelectionRows returns half-checked rows from the current native tree selection column. See the full notes.

		</AsamButton>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeInstanceDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	children?: Row[];
}

const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const observation = ref({ halfSelected: [] as string[], tableId: '', columns: 0, selectedKeys: 0 });
const rows: Row[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '研发组',
		children: [
			{ id: 11, name: '组件实现' },
			{ id: 12, name: '独立验证' }
		]
	}
];
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => page;
const loadTree = async (): Promise<AsamPage<Row>> => ({ list: rows, total: rows.length });
const transform = (response: AsamPage<Row>) => response;

function readInstance(): void {
	if (!table.value) return;
	observation.value = {
		halfSelected: table.value.getHalfSelectionRows().map((row) => row.name),
		tableId: table.value.tableId,
		columns: table.value.columns.length,
		selectedKeys: table.value.getSelection().keys.length
	};
}
</script>

Failure and retry ​

error emits an AsamDataError. success emits an AsamPage<Row>. See the full notes.

Related base components ​

  • AsamTable provides the applicable display, interaction, and public API.
  • AsamPagination provides the applicable pagination controls and public API.

Use this page's rules for data sources, models, events, and exposed members, and refer to the linked base components for the features available here. Sizes follow the ASAM base components. Examples use default.

Cross-page selection, stale data recovery, and cancellation ​

The complete example returns a page with a strict { list, total } shape. buildPageParams explicitly combines query and pagination inputs, and rowKey derives a stable identifier from each row. See the full notes.

The full example records seven data events. update:currentPage, page-change, update:pageSize, and page-size-change retain numeric payloads. Switch between 2 and 4 rows per page. See the full notes.

<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamCollapse data-testid="paged-state-contract-case">
			<AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
				<template #title><span>完整分页状态与生命周期</span></template>
				<div class="demo-slot-layout">
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="pagedStateContractBusy"
						@click="runPagedStateContract"
					>
						验证分页状态与生命周期
					</AsamButton>
					<div ref="pagedStateInjectionTarget" />
					<pre data-testid="paged-state-contract-result">{{
						JSON.stringify(pagedStateContractResult)
					}}</pre>
				</div>
			</AsamCollapseItem>
		</AsamCollapse>

		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->

			模拟接口失败
		</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="holdReload">
			开始持有分页请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="releaseHeld">
			完成持有分页请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="cancelSlow">取消慢请求</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.clearSelection()">
			清空全部选择
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.sort('id', 'descending')">
			按编号倒序
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect">读取跨页选择</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(true)">
			选择当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(false)">
			取消当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst()">
			切换当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleLast()">
			选择当前页末行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.toggleAllSelection()">
			切换当前页全选
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamDataTable
			ref="table"
			:api="api"
			:query="query"
			:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
			:transform="transform"
			:row-key="rowKey"
			:page-size="2"
			:page-sizes="[2, 4]"
			:pagination="{ layout: 'sizes, prev, pager, next, total' }"
			selectable
			border
			stripe
			size="default"
			@update:current-page="recordPage('update:currentPage', $event)"
			@update:page-size="recordPage('update:pageSize', $event)"
			@page-change="recordPage('page-change', $event)"
			@page-size-change="recordPage('page-size-change', $event)"
			@selection-change="recordSelection"
			@success="recordSuccess"
			@sort-change="sortEvents++"
			@row-click="rowEvents.push($event.id)"
			@error="recordError"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" sortable />
			<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="成员">
				<template #default="{ row }">
					<span :data-row-id="row.id">{{ row.name }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
			<template #toolbar="{ loading, stale, selection: snapshot }">
				<p
					class="example-paragraph"
					data-testid="table-toolbar"
					:data-slot-loading="String(loading)"
					:data-slot-stale="String(stale)"
					:data-slot-keys="JSON.stringify(snapshot.keys)"
					:data-slot-rows="JSON.stringify(snapshot.rows)"
				>
					已选 {{ snapshot.keys.length }}；loading={{ loading }}；stale={{ stale }}
				</p>
			</template>
			<template #append>
				<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="table-append">成员只在本地生成</p>
			</template>
			<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">当前没有成员</p></template>
		</AsamDataTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			结果：{{ result }}；成功次数：{{ successes }}；{{ error }}
		</p>
		<pre data-testid="table-selection">{{ JSON.stringify(selection) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-observation">{{ JSON.stringify(observation) }}</pre>
		<pre class="lifecycle-events" data-testid="table-lifecycle-events">{{
			JSON.stringify(events)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ sortEvents, rowEvents }) }}</pre>
		<RowKeyContract />
		<NativeSlotsContract />
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import NativeSlotsContract from './NativeSlotsContract.vue';
import RowKeyContract from './RowKeyContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLifecycleDemo' });
import { ref, computed, effectScope, createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	provideAsamData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamRecord,
	AsamRowKey,
	AsamPagedInput,
	AsamPagedConfig,
	AsamPagedState,
	AsamRequestContext,
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamTableSelection,
	AsamDataError
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { EffectScope } from 'vue';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Params extends Query, AsamPageRequest {}
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const query = { text: '' };
const failure = ref(false);
const slow = ref(false);
const held = ref(false);
const pendingReleases = new Set<() => void>();
function holdReload() {
	held.value = true;
	void reload();
}
function releaseHeld() {
	held.value = false;
	for (const finish of [...pendingReleases]) finish();
}
async function waitHeld(signal: AbortSignal) {
	signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (!held.value) return;
	await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
		const finish = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			done();
		};
		const abort = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		pendingReleases.add(finish);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (signal.aborted) abort();
	});
	signal.throwIfAborted();
}
const result = ref('');
const error = ref('');
const events = ref<{ name: string; payload: unknown }[]>([]);
function recordPage(
	name: 'update:currentPage' | 'update:pageSize' | 'page-change' | 'page-size-change',
	value: number
) {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordSelection(value: AsamTableSelection<Row>) {
	selection.value = value;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'selection-change',
		payload: { keys: [...value.keys], rows: value.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row })) }
	});
}
function recordSuccess(value: AsamPage<Row>) {
	pageRows.value = value.list;
	successes.value++;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'success',
		payload: { list: value.list.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: value.total }
	});
}
function recordError(value: AsamDataError) {
	error.value = value.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: value.kind, message: value.message } });
}
const successes = ref(0);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const rowEvents = ref<number[]>([]);
const pageRows = ref<readonly Row[]>([]);

const observation = ref<{ keys: readonly (string | number)[]; rows: readonly Row[] }>({
	keys: [],
	rows: []
});
const rows: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '成员 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row: Row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input: Query, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<Params, AsamPage<Row>> = async (params, context) => {
	await waitHeld(context.signal);
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, slow.value ? 500 : 100));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示分页接口失败');
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (page: AsamPage<Row>) => page;
async function reload() {
	const response = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (response?.status === 'success') error.value = '';
}
async function cancelSlow() {
	slow.value = true;
	const pending = table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => table.value?.cancel(), 30);
	result.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	slow.value = false;
}
function inspect() {
	const snapshot = table.value?.getSelection();
	observation.value = { keys: snapshot?.keys ?? [], rows: table.value?.getSelectionRows() ?? [] };
}

	const first = pageRows.value[0];
	if (first) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(first, selected);
}
function toggleLast() {
	const last = pageRows.value.at(-1);
	if (last) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(last, true);
}

			['missing-provider', { request: { url: '/x' } }],
			['get-data-target', { request: { url: '/x' }, pageTarget: 'data' }],
			['bad-target', { request: { url: '/x', method: 'post' }, pageTarget: 'body' }],
			['query-collision', { request: { url: '/x', params: { q: 1 } }, query: { q: 2 } }],
			['pagination-collision', { request: { url: '/x', params: { page: 1 } } }],
			['array-query', { request: { url: '/x' }, query: [] }],
			[
				'array-target',
				{ request: { url: '/x', method: 'post', data: [] }, pageTarget: 'data' }
			],
			['url-api-builder', { request: { url: '/x' }, buildPageParams: build }],
			[
				'custom-plus-target',
				{
					request: { url: '/x' },
					buildPageRequest: () => ({ url: '/custom' }),
					pageTarget: 'params'
				}
			],
			[
				'custom-async',
				{ request: { url: '/x' }, buildPageRequest: async () => ({ url: '/custom' }) }
			],
			[
				'custom-invalid-url',
				{ request: { url: '/x' }, buildPageRequest: () => ({ url: '' }) }
			]
		] as const) {
			const invalid = Reflect.apply(attach, undefined, [
				{
					source: { ...input, immediate: false },
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime({
						provider:
							name === 'missing-provider'
								? {}
								: { request: async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }) }
					})
				}
			]).state;
			urlInvalid.push({
				name,
				status: (await invalid.reload()).status,
				snapshot: snapshot(invalid)
			});
		}
		record('paged-state-url-provider-target-collision-plain-input-and-custom-builder-guards', {
			cases: urlInvalid
		});
		const stages: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		for (const [name, api, transform] of [
			[
				'transport-throw',
				() => {
					throw Error('page transport throw');
				},
				undefined
			],
			['transport-reject', () => Promise.reject(Error('page transport reject')), undefined],
			['transport-not-promise', () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }), undefined],
			['bad-response', async () => ({ data: [] }), undefined],
			[
				'transform-throw',
				async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }),
				() => {
					throw Error('page transform throw');
				}
			],
			[
				'transform-async',
				async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }),
				async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 })
			]
		] as const) {
			const checked = Reflect.apply(attach, undefined, [
				{
					source: { api, buildPageParams: build, transform, immediate: false },
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			]).state;
			stages.push({
				name,
				status: (await checked.reload()).status,
				snapshot: snapshot(checked)
			});
		}
		record('paged-state-transport-response-transform-error-stages', { cases: stages });

		const controlledPage = ref(2),
			controlledSize = ref(2),
			wrapperVersion = ref(0);
		let controlledCalls = 0;
		const controlledApi = async () => {
			controlledCalls++;
			return { list: [{ id: controlledCalls }], total: 50 };
		};
		const controlled = attach({
			source: computed<PagedContractInput>(() => {
				void wrapperVersion.value;
				return {
					api: controlledApi,
					query: { stable: 'same' },
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: controlledPage.value,
					pageSize: controlledSize.value
				};
			}),
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
			onPageChange: (page) => {
				controlledPage.value = page;
			},
			onPageSizeChange: (size) => {
				controlledSize.value = size;
			}
		}).state;
		await settle(() => controlled.hasSucceeded.value);
		controlled.toggleRowSelection(controlled.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		const wrapperBefore = snapshot(controlled);
		wrapperVersion.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		await Promise.resolve();
		record('paged-state-equivalent-wrapper-keeps-data-selection-and-request', {
			before: wrapperBefore,
			after: snapshot(controlled),
			calls: controlledCalls
		});
		controlled.setCurrentPage(3);
		await settle(() => controlled.data.value.list[0]?.id === 2);
		controlled.setPageSize(4);
		await settle(() => controlled.data.value.list[0]?.id === 3);
		record('paged-state-controlled-page-and-size-echo-do-not-duplicate-requests', {
			calls: controlledCalls,
			pageProp: controlledPage.value,
			sizeProp: controlledSize.value,
			snapshot: snapshot(controlled)
		});
		const sourceApiA = async () => ({ list: [{ id: 'source-a' }], total: 100 }),
			sourceApiB = async () => ({ list: [{ id: 'source-b' }], total: 100 }),
			chosenApi = ref(sourceApiA),
			sourceSwitch = attach({
				source: computed<PagedContractInput>(() => ({
					api: chosenApi.value,
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: 4,
					pageSize: 2
				})),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await settle(() => sourceSwitch.hasSucceeded.value);
		sourceSwitch.toggleRowSelection(sourceSwitch.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		chosenApi.value = sourceApiB;
		await settle(() => sourceSwitch.data.value.list[0]?.id === 'source-b');
		record('paged-state-source-identity-change-resets-page-selection-and-reloads', {
			snapshot: snapshot(sourceSwitch)
		});
		let manualCalls = 0;
		const manualQuery = ref({ term: 'first' }),
			manualApi = async (params: AsamRecord) => {
				manualCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: params.term }], total: 100 };
			},
			manual = attach({
				source: computed<PagedContractInput>(() => ({
					api: manualApi,
					query: manualQuery.value,
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: 3,
					pageSize: 2,
					immediate: false
				})),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await manual.reload();
		manual.toggleRowSelection(manual.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		manualQuery.value.term = 'second';
		await Promise.resolve();
		const manualPrepared = snapshot(manual),
			manualBefore = manualCalls;
		await manual.reload();
		record('paged-state-manual-query-change-prepares-stale-reset-without-transport', {
			prepared: manualPrepared,
			callsBeforeReload: manualBefore,
			callsAfterReload: manualCalls,
			final: snapshot(manual)
		});
		const epochGate = gate(),
			epochRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'scope-before' }),
			epochContexts: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		let epochCalls = 0,
			epochSuccess = 0;
		const epochApi = async (_params: AsamRecord, context: AsamRequestContext) => {
				epochContexts.push({ scope: context.scope, epoch: context.epoch });
				epochCalls++;
				return epochCalls === 2
					? epochGate.promise
					: { list: [{ id: epochCalls }], total: 1 };
			},
			epochState = attach({
				source: {
					api: epochApi,
					buildPageParams: build,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: epochRuntime,
				onSuccess: () => {
					epochSuccess++;
				}
			}).state;
		await epochState.reload();
		epochState.toggleRowSelection(epochState.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		const epochPending = epochState.reload({ force: true });
		epochRuntime.setScope('scope-after');
		const epochCancelled = await epochPending;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const epochReset = snapshot(epochState);
		epochGate.release({ list: [{ id: 'obsolete' }], total: 1 });
		await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 0));
		const epochReload = await epochState.reload();
		record('paged-state-scope-epoch-invalidates-held-job-data-selection-and-cache', {
			status: epochCancelled.status,
			reset: epochReset,
			reloadStatus: epochReload.status,
			fromCache: epochReload.status === 'success' ? epochReload.fromCache : null,
			calls: epochCalls,
			successes: epochSuccess,
			contexts: epochContexts,
			final: snapshot(epochState)
		});
		let isolatedCalls = 0;
		const isolatedApi = async () => {
				isolatedCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: isolatedCalls }], total: 1 };
			},
			isolatedRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime(),
			isolatedInput: PagedContractInput = {
				api: isolatedApi,
				buildPageParams: build,
				immediate: false
			},
			isolatedA = attach({ source: isolatedInput, runtime: isolatedRuntime }).state,
			isolatedB = attach({ source: isolatedInput, runtime: isolatedRuntime }).state;
		await Promise.all([isolatedA.reload(), isolatedB.reload()]);
		record('paged-state-uncached-consumers-have-separate-flights-and-request-keys', {
			calls: isolatedCalls,
			distinctKeys: isolatedA.requestKey.value !== isolatedB.requestKey.value,
			a: snapshot(isolatedA),
			b: snapshot(isolatedB)
		});
		const sharedCancelGate = gate();
		let sharedCancelCalls = 0;
		const sharedCancelInput: PagedContractInput = {
				api: () => {
					sharedCancelCalls++;
					return sharedCancelGate.promise;
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
				immediate: false
			},
			sharedCancelRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime(),
			sharedCancelA = attach({
				source: sharedCancelInput,
				runtime: sharedCancelRuntime
			}).state,
			sharedCancelB = attach({
				source: sharedCancelInput,
				runtime: sharedCancelRuntime
			}).state;
		const ca = sharedCancelA.reload(),
			cb = sharedCancelB.reload();
		sharedCancelA.cancel();
		const cancelledShared = await ca;
		sharedCancelGate.release({ list: [{ id: 'shared' }], total: 1 });
		const cbResult = await cb,
			rejoined = await sharedCancelA.reload();
		record('paged-state-one-shared-consumer-cancel-preserves-peer-and-rejoins-cache', {
			cancelled: cancelledShared.status,
			peer: cbResult.status,
			rejoined: rejoined.status,
			rejoinedFromCache: rejoined.status === 'success' ? rejoined.fromCache : null,
			calls: sharedCancelCalls,
			a: snapshot(sharedCancelA),
			b: snapshot(sharedCancelB)
		});
		let ttlCalls = 0;
		const ttlState = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => {
					ttlCalls++;
					return { list: [{ id: ttlCalls }], total: 1 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				cache: { ttlMs: 25 },
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await ttlState.reload();
		const ttlHit = await ttlState.reload();
		await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 40));
		const ttlExpired = await ttlState.reload();
		record('paged-state-real-cache-ttl-hit-and-expiry', {
			calls: ttlCalls,
			hit: ttlHit.status === 'success' ? ttlHit.fromCache : null,
			expired: ttlExpired.status === 'success' ? ttlExpired.fromCache : null,
			snapshot: snapshot(ttlState)
		});
		let dateCalls = 0;
		const dateApi = async () => {
				dateCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'date' }], total: 1 };
			},
			dateBuilder = () => ({ stamp: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') }),
			dateUncached = attach({
				source: { api: dateApi, buildPageParams: dateBuilder, immediate: false },
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCached = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCustom = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000, key: () => 'known-date' },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await dateUncached.reload();
		await dateCached.reload();
		await dateCustom.reload();
		record('paged-state-nonserializable-params-fallback-cache-error-and-custom-key', {
			calls: dateCalls,
			uncached: snapshot(dateUncached),
			cached: snapshot(dateCached),
			custom: snapshot(dateCustom)
		});
		const cacheGuards: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		for (const [name, key] of [
			['empty', () => ''],
			['number', () => 1],
			['async', async () => 'key'],
			[
				'throw',
				() => {
					throw Error('paged key throw');
				}
			]
		] as const) {
			let io = 0;
			const checked = Reflect.apply(attach, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => {
							io++;
							return { list: [], total: 0 };
						},
						buildPageParams: build,
						cache: { ttlMs: 100, key },
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			]).state;
			const result = await checked.reload();
			cacheGuards.push({ name, status: result.status, io, snapshot: snapshot(checked) });
		}
		record('paged-state-custom-cache-key-synchronous-nonempty-string-guards', {
			cases: cacheGuards
		});
		const rowFunction = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => ({ list: [{ key: 'row-function' }], total: 1 }),
				buildPageParams: build,
				rowKey: (row) => String(row.key),
				defaultSelectedRowKeys: ['row-function'],
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await rowFunction.reload();
		record('paged-state-custom-row-key-function-resolves-default-selection', {
			keys: rowFunction.selection.value.keys,
			rows: rowFunction.selection.value.rows,
			snapshot: snapshot(rowFunction)
		});
		let getterBad = false,
			getterCalls = 0;
		const getterTick = ref(0),
			getterApi = async () => {
				getterCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'getter' }], total: 1 };
			},
			getter = attach({
				source: () => {
					void getterTick.value;
					if (getterBad) throw Error('paged getter throw');
					return { api: getterApi, buildPageParams: build, immediate: false };
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await getter.reload();
		getterBad = true;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterFault = snapshot(getter);
		getterBad = false;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterRecovery = await getter.reload();
		record('paged-state-throwing-source-getter-retains-stale-data-and-recovers', {
			fault: getterFault,
			status: getterRecovery.status,
			calls: getterCalls,
			final: snapshot(getter)
		});
		let missingRuntime: Record<string, unknown>;
		try {
			useAsamPagedData({
				source: {
					api: async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }),
					buildPageParams: build,
					immediate: false
				}
			});
			missingRuntime = { threw: false };
		} catch (cause) {
			missingRuntime = {
				threw: true,
				kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			};
		}
		record('paged-state-missing-runtime-is-config-error', missingRuntime);

		if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && pagedStateInjectionTarget.value) {
			let injected: AsamPagedState<AsamRecord> | undefined,
				injectedCalls = 0,
				mounted = false;
			const host = document.createElement('div'),
				app = createApp(
					defineComponent({
						setup() {
							injected = useAsamPagedData<
								AsamRecord,
								AsamRecord,
								AsamPage<AsamRecord>
							>({
								source: {
									api: async () => {
										injectedCalls++;
										return { list: [{ id: 8 }], total: 1 };
									},
									buildPageParams: build,
									immediate: false
								}
							});
							const state = injected;
							return () =>
								h(
									'output',
									{ 'data-testid': 'paged-state-injected-output' },
									JSON.stringify(snapshot(state))
								);
						}
					})
				);
			pagedStateInjectionTarget.value.append(host);
			provideAsamData(app, {});
			try {
				app.mount(host);
				mounted = true;
				if (!injected) throw Error('Missing injected paged state');
				const noInitialRequest = injectedCalls === 0,
					before = snapshot(injected);
				await injected.reload();
				await nextTick();
				const after = snapshot(injected),
					rendered = host.querySelector('output') !== null,
					renderedSnapshot = JSON.parse(
						host.querySelector('output')?.textContent ?? '{}'
					);
				app.unmount();
				mounted = false;
				record('paged-state-mounted-app-injection-and-unmount-cleanup', {
					noInitialRequest,
					before,
					after,
					rendered,
					renderedSnapshot,
					calls: injectedCalls,
					cancelledReload: (await injected.reload()).status
				});
			} finally {
				if (mounted) app.unmount();
				host.remove();
			}
		}

		pagedStateContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		pagedStateContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'paged-state-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		for (const scope of scopes) scope.stop();
		pagedStateContractBusy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.lifecycle-events {
	max-height: 32rem;
	overflow: auto;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-slot-layout {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
}
.demo-slot-layout > .el-button {
	justify-self: start;
}
.demo-slot-layout > :is(p, pre, output) {
	margin-block: 0;
}
.demo-slot-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
.demo-slot-actions > .el-button + .el-button {
	margin-left: 0;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
vue
<template>
	<AsamCollapse data-testid="row-key-boundary-case">
		<AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
			<template #title><span>公开分页行键边界</span></template>
			<div class="demo-slot-layout">
				<AsamButton
					type="default"
					native-type="button"
					:disabled="busy"
					@click="runRowKeyBoundary"
				>
					验证行键边界
				</AsamButton>
				<pre data-testid="row-key-boundary-result">{{ JSON.stringify(observations) }}</pre>
			</div>
		</AsamCollapseItem>
	</AsamCollapse>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, effectScope } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const busy = ref(false);
const observations = ref<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);
async function runRowKeyBoundary() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	const results: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
	try {
		const cases: { name: string; key: unknown; rows: object[]; valid: boolean }[] = [
			{ name: 'own-empty-string', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: '' }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-zero', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 0 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-negative', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: -1 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-fraction', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1.5 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-string-callback', key: () => 'callback', rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-number-callback', key: () => 7, rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-NaN', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: NaN }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-Infinity', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: Infinity }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-boolean', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: true }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-null', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: null }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-object', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: {} }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'missing-own-key', key: 'id', rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{ name: 'inherited-key', key: 'id', rows: [Object.create({ id: 8 })], valid: false },
			{ name: 'duplicate-key', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1 }, { id: 1 }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'async-resolved', key: async () => 1, rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{
				name: 'async-rejected',
				key: () => Promise.reject(Error('row-key-rejected')),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-resolved',
				key: () => ({ then: (done: (value: number) => void) => done(1) }),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-rejected',
				key: () => ({
					then: (_done: unknown, reject: (cause: Error) => void) =>
						reject(Error('row-key-thenable-rejected'))
				}),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'callback-throws',
				key: () => {
					throw Error('row-key-thrown');
				},
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			}
		];
		for (const item of cases) {
			const scope = effectScope();
			let calls = 0;
			const state = scope.run(() =>
				Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
					{
						source: {
							api: async () => {
								calls++;
								return { list: item.rows, total: item.rows.length };
							},
							buildPageParams: () => ({}),
							rowKey: item.key,
							immediate: false
						},
						runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
					}
				])
			);
			try {
				const result = await state.reload();
				const row = {
					phase: item.name,
					valid: item.valid,
					status: result.status,
					calls,
					errorKind: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
					errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
					dataLength: state.data.value.list.length,
					hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
					selection: state.getSelection()
				};
				if (item.valid) {
					state.toggleRowSelection(item.rows[0], true);
					row.selection = state.getSelection();
				}
				results.push(row);
			} finally {
				scope.stop();
			}
		}
		const scope = effectScope();
		let invalid = false;
		const state = scope.run(() =>
			Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => ({ list: [{ id: 9 }], total: 1 }),
						buildPageParams: () => ({}),
						rowKey: () =>
							invalid ? Promise.reject(Error('row-key-selection-rejected')) : 9,
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			])
		);
		try {
			await state.reload();
			invalid = true;
			const errors: { operation: string; kind: string | null; message: string }[] = [];
			for (const operation of ['toggleRowSelection', 'selectPage']) {
				try {
					if (operation === 'toggleRowSelection')
						state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 9 }, true);
					else state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
				} catch (cause) {
					errors.push({
						operation,
						kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
						message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
					});
				}
			}
			const afterInvalid = state.getSelection();
			invalid = false;
			state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
			results.push({
				phase: 'selection-synchronous-key-guard-and-recovery',
				errors,
				afterInvalid,
				recovered: state.getSelection()
			});
		} finally {
			scope.stop();
		}
		await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 20));
		observations.value = results;
	} catch (cause) {
		observations.value = [
			...results,
			{
				phase: 'unexpected-failure',
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			}
		];
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamRequestContext
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
type Mode = 'empty' | 'row' | 'failure';
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const activeNames = ref<string[]>([]);
const query = {};
const mode = ref<Mode>('empty');
const customSlots = ref(true);
const layout = ref<'fixed' | 'auto'>('fixed');
const calls = ref(0);
const result = ref('unloaded');
let complete: (() => void) | undefined;
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<AsamPageRequest, AsamPage<Row>> = (
	_params: AsamPageRequest,
	context: AsamRequestContext
) =>
	new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		calls.value++;
		const requested = mode.value;
		const clear = () => {
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			complete = undefined;
		};
		const abort = () => {
			clear();
			reject(new Error('插槽请求已取消'));
		};
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		complete = () => {
			clear();
			if (requested === 'failure') reject(new Error('插槽示例失败'));
			else
				resolve({
					list: requested === 'empty' ? [] : [{ id: 1, name: '插槽成员 1' }],
					total: requested === 'empty' ? 0 : 1
				});
		};
	});
async function load(next: Mode) {
	mode.value = next;
	result.value = 'pending';
	const outcome = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = outcome?.status ?? 'missing';
}
function release() {
	complete?.();
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => table.value?.cancel());
</script>

<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamCollapse data-testid="paged-state-contract-case">
			<AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
				<template #title><span>完整分页状态与生命周期</span></template>
				<div class="demo-slot-layout">
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="pagedStateContractBusy"
						@click="runPagedStateContract"
					>
						验证分页状态与生命周期

					<div ref="pagedStateInjectionTarget" />
					<pre data-testid="paged-state-contract-result">{{
						JSON.stringify(pagedStateContractResult)
					}}</pre>
				</div>
			</AsamCollapseItem>
		</AsamCollapse>

		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->

			模拟接口失败
		</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="holdReload">
			开始持有分页请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="releaseHeld">
			完成持有分页请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="cancelSlow">取消慢请求</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.clearSelection()">
			清空全部选择
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.sort('id', 'descending')">
			按编号倒序
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect">读取跨页选择</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(true)">
			选择当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(false)">
			取消当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst()">
			切换当前页首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="toggleLast()">
			选择当前页末行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="table?.toggleAllSelection()">
			切换当前页全选
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamDataTable
			ref="table"
			:api="api"
			:query="query"
			:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
			:transform="transform"
			:row-key="rowKey"
			:page-size="2"
			:page-sizes="[2, 4]"
			:pagination="{ layout: 'sizes, prev, pager, next, total' }"
			selectable
			border
			stripe
			size="default"
			@update:current-page="recordPage('update:currentPage', $event)"
			@update:page-size="recordPage('update:pageSize', $event)"
			@page-change="recordPage('page-change', $event)"
			@page-size-change="recordPage('page-size-change', $event)"
			@selection-change="recordSelection"
			@success="recordSuccess"
			@sort-change="sortEvents++"
			@row-click="rowEvents.push($event.id)"
			@error="recordError"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" sortable />
			<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="成员">
				<template #default="{ row }">
					<span :data-row-id="row.id">{{ row.name }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
			<template #toolbar="{ loading, stale, selection: snapshot }">
				<p
					class="example-paragraph"
					data-testid="table-toolbar"
					:data-slot-loading="String(loading)"
					:data-slot-stale="String(stale)"
					:data-slot-keys="JSON.stringify(snapshot.keys)"
					:data-slot-rows="JSON.stringify(snapshot.rows)"
				>
					已选 {{ snapshot.keys.length }}；loading={{ loading }}；stale={{ stale }}
				</p>
			</template>
			<template #append>
				<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="table-append">成员只在本地生成</p>
			</template>
			<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">当前没有成员</p></template>
		</AsamDataTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			结果：{{ result }}；成功次数：{{ successes }}；{{ error }}
		</p>
		<pre data-testid="table-selection">{{ JSON.stringify(selection) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-observation">{{ JSON.stringify(observation) }}</pre>
		<pre class="lifecycle-events" data-testid="table-lifecycle-events">{{
			JSON.stringify(events)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ sortEvents, rowEvents }) }}</pre>
		<RowKeyContract />
		<NativeSlotsContract />
	</section>

<script setup>
import NativeSlotsContract from './NativeSlotsContract.vue';
import RowKeyContract from './RowKeyContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLifecycleDemo' });
import { ref, computed, effectScope, createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	provideAsamData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const table = ref();
const query = { text: '' };
const failure = ref(false);
const slow = ref(false);
const held = ref(false);
const pendingReleases = new Set();
function holdReload() {
	held.value = true;
	void reload();
}
function releaseHeld() {
	held.value = false;
	for (const finish of [...pendingReleases]) finish();
}
async function waitHeld(signal) {
	signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (!held.value) return;
	await new Promise((done, reject) => {
		const finish = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			done();
		};
		const abort = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		pendingReleases.add(finish);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (signal.aborted) abort();
	});
	signal.throwIfAborted();
}
const result = ref('');
const error = ref('');
const events = ref([]);
function recordPage(name, value) {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordSelection(value) {
	selection.value = value;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'selection-change',
		payload: { keys: [...value.keys], rows: value.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row })) }
	});
}
function recordSuccess(value) {
	pageRows.value = value.list;
	successes.value++;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'success',
		payload: { list: value.list.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: value.total }
	});
}
function recordError(value) {
	error.value = value.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: value.kind, message: value.message } });
}
const successes = ref(0);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const rowEvents = ref([]);
const pageRows = ref([]);
const selection = ref({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const observation = ref({
	keys: [],
	rows: []
});
const rows = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '成员 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input, page) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api = async (params, context) => {
	await waitHeld(context.signal);
	await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, slow.value ? 500 : 100));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示分页接口失败');
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (page) => page;
async function reload() {
	const response = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (response?.status === 'success') error.value = '';
}
async function cancelSlow() {
	slow.value = true;
	const pending = table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => table.value?.cancel(), 30);
	result.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	slow.value = false;
}
function inspect() {
	const snapshot = table.value?.getSelection();
	observation.value = { keys: snapshot?.keys ?? [], rows: table.value?.getSelectionRows() ?? [] };
}
function toggleFirst(selected) {
	const first = pageRows.value[0];
	if (first) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(first, selected);
}
function toggleLast() {
	const last = pageRows.value.at(-1);
	if (last) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(last, true);
}
const pagedStateContractResult = ref([]);
const pagedStateContractBusy = ref(false);
const pagedStateInjectionTarget = ref();
async function runPagedStateContract() {
	pagedStateContractBusy.value = true;
	pagedStateContractResult.value = [];
	const observations = [],
		scopes = [];
	const record = (phase, state) => observations.push({ phase, state });
	const attach = (config) => {
		const scope = effectScope();
		scopes.push(scope);
		const state = scope.run(() => useAsamPagedData(config));
		if (!state) throw Error('Missing paged state');
		return { state, scope };
	};
	const snapshot = (state) => ({
		ids: state.data.value.list.map((row) => row.id),
		total: state.data.value.total,
		loading: state.loading.value,
		error: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
		errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
		stale: state.stale.value,
		hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
		empty: state.empty.value,
		currentPage: state.currentPage.value,
		pageSize: state.pageSize.value,
		dataKeySet: state.dataKey.value !== null,
		requestKeySet: state.requestKey.value !== null,
		keysMatch: state.dataKey.value !== null && state.dataKey.value === state.requestKey.value,
		resolved:
			state.resolvedPage.value === null
				? null
				: {
						currentPage: state.resolvedPage.value.currentPage,
						pageSize: state.resolvedPage.value.pageSize,
						queryKeyNonempty: state.resolvedPage.value.queryKey.length > 0
					},
		selection: {
			keys: state.selection.value.keys,
			ids: state.selection.value.rows.map((row) => row.id)
		}
	});
	const build = (query, page) => ({
		...query,
		p: page.currentPage,
		s: page.pageSize
	});
	const gate = () => {
		let release = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			},
			reject = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			};
		const promise = new Promise((done, fail) => {
			release = done;
			reject = fail;
		});
		return { promise, release, reject };
	};
	const settle = async (check) => {
		for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !check(); i++) await Promise.resolve();
		if (!check()) throw Error('Paged state did not settle within microtasks');
	};
	try {
		const firstGate = gate(),
			nextGate = gate(),
			failedGate = gate(),
			emptyGate = gate(),
			jobs = [firstGate, nextGate, failedGate, emptyGate];
		let calls = 0,
			successes = 0,
			localErrors = 0,
			notifications = 0,
			successSame = false;
		const pageEvents = [],
			sizeEvents = [],
			selectionEvents = [],
			parameters = [],
			contexts = [];
		const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({
				scope: 'paged-contract',
				provider: {
					onError: () => {
						notifications++;
					}
				}
			}),
			owner = attach({
				source: {
					api: (params, context) => {
						parameters.push(params);
						contexts.push({
							scope: context.scope,
							epoch: context.epoch,
							signalAborted: context.signal.aborted
						});
						return jobs[calls++].promise;
					},
					query: { term: 'initial' },
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: 2,
					pageSize: 2,
					defaultSelectedRowKeys: [1, '1', 'future'],
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime,
				onSuccess: (data) => {
					successes++;
					successSame = data === owner.state.data.value;
				},
				onError: () => {
					localErrors++;
				},
				onPageChange: (page) => pageEvents.push(page),
				onPageSizeChange: (size) => sizeEvents.push(size),
				onSelectionChange: (selection) => selectionEvents.push(selection.keys)
			}),
			state = owner.state;
		record('paged-state-complete-public-members-initial-default-keys-and-pagination', {
			members: Object.keys(state),
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			calls,
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		const first = state.reload();
		record('paged-state-held-api-build-params-and-original-context', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			calls,
			parameters: [...parameters],
			contexts: [...contexts]
		});
		const host = {
			list: [
				{ id: 1, name: 'Numeric', meta: { count: 1 } },
				{ id: '1', name: 'String', meta: { count: 1 } }
			],
			total: 6
		};
		firstGate.release(host);
		const firstResult = await first;
		host.list[0].meta.count = 9;
		record('paged-state-success-resolved-page-frozen-host-snapshot-and-callback', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			status: firstResult.status,
			fromCache: firstResult.status === 'success' ? firstResult.fromCache : null,
			successes,
			successSame,
			frozen:
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list[0]) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list[0]?.meta),
			hostCount: host.list[0].meta.count,
			snapshotCount: Reflect.get(Object(state.data.value.list[0].meta), 'count'),
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		state.clearSelection();
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0]);
		state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 'outsider' }, true);
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[1], true);
		state.selectPage([state.data.value.list[1]]);
		const selection = state.getSelection();
		record('paged-state-selection-typed-keys-toggle-page-filter-and-frozen-snapshot', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			samePublicSelection: selection === state.selection.value,
			frozen:
				Object.isFrozen(selection) &&
				Object.isFrozen(selection.keys) &&
				Object.isFrozen(selection.rows),
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		state.setCurrentPage(3);
		const pageChanged = snapshot(state),
			next = state.reload();
		nextGate.release({
			list: [
				{ id: 3, name: 'Third' },
				{ id: 4, name: 'Fourth' }
			],
			total: 6
		});
		await next;
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0], true);
		state.selectPage([state.data.value.list[1]]);
		record('paged-state-page-navigation-retains-cross-page-rows-and-selected-keys', {
			beforeReload: pageChanged,
			after: snapshot(state),
			parameters: [...parameters],
			pageEvents: [...pageEvents],
			sizeEvents: [...sizeEvents]
		});
		const original = Error('owned paged request failure'),
			failed = state.reload();
		failedGate.reject(original);
		const failure = await failed;
		const staleSelection = state.getSelection();
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0], true);
		state.selectPage([]);

			peer: cbResult.status,
			rejoined: rejoined.status,
			rejoinedFromCache: rejoined.status === 'success' ? rejoined.fromCache : null,
			calls: sharedCancelCalls,
			a: snapshot(sharedCancelA),
			b: snapshot(sharedCancelB)
		});
		let ttlCalls = 0;
		const ttlState = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => {
					ttlCalls++;
					return { list: [{ id: ttlCalls }], total: 1 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				cache: { ttlMs: 25 },
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await ttlState.reload();
		const ttlHit = await ttlState.reload();
		await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 40));
		const ttlExpired = await ttlState.reload();
		record('paged-state-real-cache-ttl-hit-and-expiry', {
			calls: ttlCalls,
			hit: ttlHit.status === 'success' ? ttlHit.fromCache : null,
			expired: ttlExpired.status === 'success' ? ttlExpired.fromCache : null,
			snapshot: snapshot(ttlState)
		});
		let dateCalls = 0;
		const dateApi = async () => {
				dateCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'date' }], total: 1 };
			},
			dateBuilder = () => ({ stamp: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') }),
			dateUncached = attach({
				source: { api: dateApi, buildPageParams: dateBuilder, immediate: false },
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCached = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCustom = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000, key: () => 'known-date' },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await dateUncached.reload();
		await dateCached.reload();
		await dateCustom.reload();
		record('paged-state-nonserializable-params-fallback-cache-error-and-custom-key', {
			calls: dateCalls,
			uncached: snapshot(dateUncached),
			cached: snapshot(dateCached),
			custom: snapshot(dateCustom)
		});
		const cacheGuards = [];
		for (const [name, key] of [
			['empty', () => ''],
			['number', () => 1],
			['async', async () => 'key'],
			[
				'throw',
				() => {
					throw Error('paged key throw');
				}
			]
		]) {
			let io = 0;
			const checked = Reflect.apply(attach, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => {
							io++;
							return { list: [], total: 0 };
						},
						buildPageParams: build,
						cache: { ttlMs: 100, key },
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			]).state;
			const result = await checked.reload();
			cacheGuards.push({ name, status: result.status, io, snapshot: snapshot(checked) });
		}
		record('paged-state-custom-cache-key-synchronous-nonempty-string-guards', {
			cases: cacheGuards
		});
		const rowFunction = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => ({ list: [{ key: 'row-function' }], total: 1 }),
				buildPageParams: build,
				rowKey: (row) => String(row.key),
				defaultSelectedRowKeys: ['row-function'],
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await rowFunction.reload();
		record('paged-state-custom-row-key-function-resolves-default-selection', {
			keys: rowFunction.selection.value.keys,
			rows: rowFunction.selection.value.rows,
			snapshot: snapshot(rowFunction)
		});
		let getterBad = false,
			getterCalls = 0;
		const getterTick = ref(0),
			getterApi = async () => {
				getterCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'getter' }], total: 1 };
			},
			getter = attach({
				source: () => {
					void getterTick.value;
					if (getterBad) throw Error('paged getter throw');
					return { api: getterApi, buildPageParams: build, immediate: false };
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await getter.reload();
		getterBad = true;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterFault = snapshot(getter);
		getterBad = false;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterRecovery = await getter.reload();
		record('paged-state-throwing-source-getter-retains-stale-data-and-recovers', {
			fault: getterFault,
			status: getterRecovery.status,
			calls: getterCalls,
			final: snapshot(getter)
		});
		let missingRuntime;
		try {
			useAsamPagedData({
				source: {
					api: async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }),
					buildPageParams: build,
					immediate: false
				}
			});
			missingRuntime = { threw: false };
		} catch (cause) {
			missingRuntime = {
				threw: true,
				kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			};
		}
		record('paged-state-missing-runtime-is-config-error', missingRuntime);
		if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && pagedStateInjectionTarget.value) {
			let injected,
				injectedCalls = 0,
				mounted = false;
			const host = document.createElement('div'),
				app = createApp(
					defineComponent({
						setup() {
							injected = useAsamPagedData({
								source: {
									api: async () => {
										injectedCalls++;
										return { list: [{ id: 8 }], total: 1 };
									},
									buildPageParams: build,
									immediate: false
								}
							});
							const state = injected;
							return () =>
								h(
									'output',
									{ 'data-testid': 'paged-state-injected-output' },
									JSON.stringify(snapshot(state))
								);
						}
					})
				);
			pagedStateInjectionTarget.value.append(host);
			provideAsamData(app, {});
			try {
				app.mount(host);
				mounted = true;
				if (!injected) throw Error('Missing injected paged state');
				const noInitialRequest = injectedCalls === 0,
					before = snapshot(injected);
				await injected.reload();
				await nextTick();
				const after = snapshot(injected),
					rendered = host.querySelector('output') !== null,
					renderedSnapshot = JSON.parse(
						host.querySelector('output')?.textContent ?? '{}'
					);
				app.unmount();
				mounted = false;
				record('paged-state-mounted-app-injection-and-unmount-cleanup', {
					noInitialRequest,
					before,
					after,
					rendered,
					renderedSnapshot,
					calls: injectedCalls,
					cancelledReload: (await injected.reload()).status
				});
			} finally {
				if (mounted) app.unmount();
				host.remove();
			}
		}
		pagedStateContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		pagedStateContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'paged-state-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		for (const scope of scopes) scope.stop();
		pagedStateContractBusy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCollapse data-testid="row-key-boundary-case">
		<AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
			<template #title><span>公开分页行键边界</span></template>
			<div class="demo-slot-layout">
				<AsamButton
					type="default"
					native-type="button"
					:disabled="busy"
					@click="runRowKeyBoundary"
				>
					验证行键边界
				</AsamButton>
				<pre data-testid="row-key-boundary-result">{{ JSON.stringify(observations) }}</pre>
			</div>
		</AsamCollapseItem>
	</AsamCollapse>
</template>
<script setup>
import { ref, effectScope } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const busy = ref(false);
const observations = ref([]);
async function runRowKeyBoundary() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	const results = [];
	try {
		const cases = [
			{ name: 'own-empty-string', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: '' }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-zero', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 0 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-negative', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: -1 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-fraction', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1.5 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-string-callback', key: () => 'callback', rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-number-callback', key: () => 7, rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-NaN', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: NaN }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-Infinity', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: Infinity }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-boolean', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: true }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-null', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: null }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-object', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: {} }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'missing-own-key', key: 'id', rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{ name: 'inherited-key', key: 'id', rows: [Object.create({ id: 8 })], valid: false },
			{ name: 'duplicate-key', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1 }, { id: 1 }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'async-resolved', key: async () => 1, rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{
				name: 'async-rejected',
				key: () => Promise.reject(Error('row-key-rejected')),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-resolved',
				key: () => ({ then: (done) => done(1) }),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-rejected',
				key: () => ({
					then: (_done, reject) => reject(Error('row-key-thenable-rejected'))
				}),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'callback-throws',
				key: () => {
					throw Error('row-key-thrown');
				},
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			}
		];
		for (const item of cases) {
			const scope = effectScope();
			let calls = 0;
			const state = scope.run(() =>
				Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
					{
						source: {
							api: async () => {
								calls++;
								return { list: item.rows, total: item.rows.length };
							},
							buildPageParams: () => ({}),
							rowKey: item.key,
							immediate: false
						},
						runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
					}
				])
			);
			try {
				const result = await state.reload();
				const row = {
					phase: item.name,
					valid: item.valid,
					status: result.status,
					calls,
					errorKind: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
					errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
					dataLength: state.data.value.list.length,
					hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
					selection: state.getSelection()
				};
				if (item.valid) {
					state.toggleRowSelection(item.rows[0], true);
					row.selection = state.getSelection();
				}
				results.push(row);
			} finally {
				scope.stop();
			}
		}
		const scope = effectScope();
		let invalid = false;
		const state = scope.run(() =>
			Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => ({ list: [{ id: 9 }], total: 1 }),
						buildPageParams: () => ({}),
						rowKey: () =>
							invalid ? Promise.reject(Error('row-key-selection-rejected')) : 9,
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			])
		);
		try {
			await state.reload();
			invalid = true;
			const errors = [];
			for (const operation of ['toggleRowSelection', 'selectPage']) {
				try {
					if (operation === 'toggleRowSelection')
						state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 9 }, true);
					else state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
				} catch (cause) {
					errors.push({
						operation,
						kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
						message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
					});
				}
			}
			const afterInvalid = state.getSelection();
			invalid = false;
			state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
			results.push({
				phase: 'selection-synchronous-key-guard-and-recovery',
				errors,
				afterInvalid,
				recovered: state.getSelection()
			});
		} finally {
			scope.stop();
		}
		await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 20));
		observations.value = results;
	} catch (cause) {
		observations.value = [
			...results,
			{
				phase: 'unexpected-failure',
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			}
		];
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const table = ref();
const activeNames = ref([]);
const query = {};
const mode = ref('empty');
const customSlots = ref(true);
const layout = ref('fixed');
const calls = ref(0);
const result = ref('unloaded');
let complete;
const buildPageParams = (_query, page) => ({ ...page });
const api = (_params, context) =>
	new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		calls.value++;
		const requested = mode.value;
		const clear = () => {
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			complete = undefined;
		};
		const abort = () => {
			clear();
			reject(new Error('插槽请求已取消'));
		};
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		complete = () => {
			clear();
			if (requested === 'failure') reject(new Error('插槽示例失败'));
			else
				resolve({
					list: requested === 'empty' ? [] : [{ id: 1, name: '插槽成员 1' }],
					total: requested === 'empty' ? 0 : 1
				});
		};
	});
async function load(next) {
	mode.value = next;
	result.value = 'pending';
	const outcome = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = outcome?.status ?? 'missing';
}
function release() {
	complete?.();
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => table.value?.cancel());
</script>

Standalone pagination state and request lifecycle ​

Custom tables can use useAsamPagedData(config) for the same pagination protocol. See the full notes.

Configuration Contract
api + buildPageParams The builder synchronously receives the query and { currentPage, pageSize }. The API returns a Promise and receives the original request context.
request Merges the query and pagination fields into params by default. The provider's pagination configuration can supply the parameter names.
pageTarget: 'data' Applies to non-GET requests. Fields in the base target, query, and pagination parameters must have distinct names.
buildPageRequest Synchronously builds the complete URL request. Use this by itself among the request builder options.
transform Synchronously returns { list, total } and takes precedence over the provider's adaptPage. Required for a custom row type.
queryKey Synchronously returns a nonempty string for queries that cannot be serialized stably by default. A change resets the page and clears selection.
cache false or { ttlMs, key? }. The TTL must be a positive safe integer, and key must synchronously return a nonempty string.
rowKey Defaults to 'id'. A field name or synchronous function can supply a string or finite number. Keys must be unique on each page.
defaultSelectedRowKeys Number and string keys retain their types. Keys for unknown rows can be retained before the first load and resolved to row snapshots when the rows arrive.
currentPage / pageSize Positive safe integers. A page size change resets to the first page. Echoing a controlled value preserves the current request.

AsamApiPageSource<Q, P, R, T> declares the API function, query, pagination builder, and transform. See the full notes.

State or method Behavior
data, loading, error, stale, hasSucceeded, empty Read-only refs. Failure retains the last successful data and marks it stale. empty is true only for a successful empty page with no loading, error, or stale state.
dataKey, requestKey, resolvedPage The keys identify successful data and pending request inputs. resolvedPage stores the successful page number, page size, and queryKey.
currentPage, pageSize, selection Read-only refs. Call the public methods to update pagination and selection.
reload({ force? }) Resolves to success, error, or cancelled. force bypasses cache reads and shares the same forced request.
cancel() Settles the current wait as cancelled. Other consumers of a shared request can continue. Late results leave the cancelling consumer's state untouched.
setCurrentPage(page), setPageSize(size) Automatic mode requests the new page. Manual mode prepares the inputs and marks previous data stale.
getSelection(), clearSelection() Read a frozen selection snapshot with getSelection(). Repeatedly clearing the empty selection emits no further change.
toggleRowSelection(row, selected?), selectPage(rows) Select from the current successful page while retaining selections on other pages. Stale data blocks new selections and whole-page selection. Deselecting an already selected row remains available.

A zero total normalizes the page number to 1. If the page is beyond the last page, the hook adjusts the page and tries once more. A second out-of-range response produces a response error. See the full notes.

onSuccess receives the frozen normalized page, and onError receives the structured error. onPageChange and onPageSizeChange receive numbers. onSelectionChange receives the full read-only selection snapshot. The host remains responsible for updating its controlled state.

Use the instance methods to manage current-page selection and read cross-page keys and resolved rows. See the full notes.

Native presentation of the current page ​

The full example combines fixed headers and columns, two levels of grouped headers, column and header templates, row numbering, current-row highlighting, native sorting and filtering, expandable content, summaries, status styling, merged status cells, and overflow tooltips. See the full notes.

The height controls demonstrate a scroll area with maxHeight=150 and a fixed height with height=310 and maxHeight=310. The layout control switches tableLayout between fixed and auto. The request counter lets you check that these display changes reuse the same data. See the full notes.

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeFeaturesDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
	status: string;
	note: string;
}
const rows: Row[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '林一',
		amount: 10,
		status: '准备',
		note: '本地演示备注用于显示完整的原生溢出提示内容。'
	},
	{ id: 2, name: '陈二', amount: 20, status: '准备', note: '第二行备注' },
	{ id: 3, name: '许三', amount: 30, status: '进行', note: '第三行备注' }
];
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const loadedRows = ref<readonly Row[]>([]);
const currentKey = ref<string | number>();
const expandedKeys = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const filters = ref<Record<string, string[]>>({});
const expanded = ref<number | null>(null);
const current = ref<number | null>(null);
const merged = ref(false);
const height = ref<string | number | undefined>(310);
const maxHeight = ref<string | number>();
const layout = ref<'fixed' | 'auto'>('fixed');
const objectSpan = ref(false);
const defaultSpan = ref(false);
const constantClass = ref(false);
const renderVNode = ref(false);
const showSummary = ref(true);
const statusFilters = [
	{ text: '准备', value: '准备' },
	{ text: '进行', value: '进行' }
];
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => page;
const api = async (): Promise<AsamPage<Row>> => {
	pageCalls.value++;
	return { list: rows, total: rows.length };
};
const transform = (page: AsamPage<Row>) => page;
const index = (at: number) => at + 101;
const filterStatus = (value: string, row: Row) => row.status === value;
const summary: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['summaryMethod']> = ({ columns, data }) =>
	columns.map((column, at) =>
		at === 0
			? renderVNode.value
				? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-label' }, '合计')
				: '合计'
			: column.property === 'amount'
				? renderVNode.value
					? h(
							'span',
							{ 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-total' },
							String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
						)
					: String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
				: ''
	);
const span: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['spanMethod']> = ({ row, column }) => {
	if (defaultSpan.value) return undefined;
	const rowspan =
		!merged.value || column.property !== 'status' ? 1 : row.id === 1 ? 2 : row.id === 2 ? 0 : 1;
	const colspan = rowspan === 0 ? 0 : 1;
	return objectSpan.value ? { rowspan, colspan } : [rowspan, colspan];
};
const rowClass: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['rowClassName']> = ({ row }) =>
	row.id === 3 ? 'native-status-row' : '';
const tooltip: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['tooltipFormatter']> = ({ row }) =>
	renderVNode.value
		? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'tooltip-vnode-content' }, `${row.name}：${row.note}`)
		: `${row.name}：${row.note}`;
</script>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeFeaturesDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const rows = [
	{
		id: 1,

		amount: 10,

	},
	{ id: 2, name: '陈二', amount: 20, status: '准备', note: '第二行备注' },
	{ id: 3, name: '许三', amount: 30, status: '进行', note: '第三行备注' }
];
const table = ref();
const loadedRows = ref([]);
const currentKey = ref();
const expandedKeys = ref([]);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const filters = ref({});
const expanded = ref(null);

const merged = ref(false);
const height = ref(310);
const maxHeight = ref();
const layout = ref('fixed');
const objectSpan = ref(false);
const defaultSpan = ref(false);
const constantClass = ref(false);
const renderVNode = ref(false);
const showSummary = ref(true);
const statusFilters = [
	{ text: '准备', value: '准备' },
	{ text: '进行', value: '进行' }
];
const buildPageParams = (_query, page) => page;
const api = async () => {
	pageCalls.value++;
	return { list: rows, total: rows.length };
};
const transform = (page) => page;
const index = (at) => at + 101;
const filterStatus = (value, row) => row.status === value;
const summary = ({ columns, data }) =>
	columns.map((column, at) =>
		at === 0
			? renderVNode.value
				? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-label' }, '合计')
				: '合计'
			: column.property === 'amount'
				? renderVNode.value
					? h(

						)
					: String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
				: ''

const span = ({ row, column }) => {
	if (defaultSpan.value) return undefined;
	const rowspan =
		!merged.value || column.property !== 'status' ? 1 : row.id === 1 ? 2 : row.id === 2 ? 0 : 1;
	const colspan = rowspan === 0 ? 0 : 1;
	return objectSpan.value ? { rowspan, colspan } : [rowspan, colspan];
};
const rowClass = ({ row }) => (row.id === 3 ? 'native-status-row' : '');
const tooltip = ({ row }) =>
	renderVNode.value
		? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'tooltip-vnode-content' }, `${row.name}：${row.note}`)
		: `${row.name}：${row.note}`;

The callback controls demonstrate text and VNode results for summaries and tooltips, array and object results for spanMethod, and string and generic function forms for rowClassName. See the full notes.

Native tree loading and row keys ​

currentRowKey, expandRowKeys, and updateKeyChildren use the original ASAM keys derived by rowKey. The number 1 and the string "1" identify distinct rows. Pass the original key as-is. See the full notes.

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLazyTreeKeysDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: string | number;
	name: string;
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const currentKey = ref<string | number>();
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const loads = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);

	loads.value.push(row.id);

		}
	]);
}

The toolbar slot's selection preserves the full set of original keys and business rows. loading and stale are booleans. Hold and complete a request in the pagination example to observe loading, failure with stale data, and recovery. Place AsamTableColumn directly inside the unscoped default slot. Each column provides its own row scope.

Internal row key resolution ​

Configure the public rowKey as a field name or a synchronous callback. The pagination and table layers read and validate it. See the full notes.

Expand the pagination row-key section of the lifecycle example to try the public behavior. See the full notes.

append and empty are unscoped slots. DataTable passes them through AsamTable to the native Table. See the full notes.

On a successful empty page, emptyText supplies the caller's message when there is no empty slot. Omitting it or passing undefined keeps the default “No data” text. The data table supplies its own messages before the first load, while loading, and on an error. The empty slot takes priority over empty text.

In the lifecycle example's default-column and slot section, hold and complete a request for an empty page, a page with members, or a failure. Custom empty content appears before the first load and on a successful empty page. When member rows load, the empty content disappears and the appended note stays visible. A later failure keeps the last successful rows visible. The empty content reappears after a successful empty response. Turn off the custom slots to see the native empty text, then turn them on to restore the custom content.

In the pinned native 2.14.7 release, append appears before the summary in fixed layout and after the in-body summary in auto layout. See the full notes.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only when the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. See the full notes.

Call retry() with no arguments. It returns the Promise from reload({ force: true }) with a success, error, or cancelled branch of AsamReloadResult<AsamPage<Row>>. Retrying preserves the current query, page, and selection.

Providing the slot replaces the entire default local error region, even if the supplied slot renders empty content. With the slot omitted, the component displays its error message, stale-data hint, and retry button. The slot requires a current error. empty, loading, and the other base slots keep their original scopes. The base table owns its separate empty-data display.

In the complete TypeScript and JavaScript example, trigger a failure and await the slot's retry() result. After a success, trigger a refresh failure to see the existing result and model retained. Each mount creates an isolated child app with a local provider.
