<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamDataTableSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;

const control = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Item>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const buildPageParams = () => ({});
const transform = (rows: readonly Item[]) => ({ list: rows, total: rows.length });
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataTableSlots<Item>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

Additional usage notes ​

Request and pagination overrides ​

Choose either api with the required buildPageParams, or request with buildPageRequest or pageTarget as needed. Supply transform for a concrete row type to convert the response to AsamPage<Row>. The data layer owns the query, page number, page size, selected keys, data, and loading. Use pagination only for display settings. total, currentPage, pageSize, disabled, and static data are reserved by the data layer.

Selection, events, and instance methods ​

selection-change emits a cross-page { keys, rows } snapshot. getSelection() returns the same snapshot, getSelectionRows() returns the resolved rows, and clearSelection() clears selection across pages. The toolbar slot receives selection, loading, and stale. Use selection.keys.length for the selection count. Refer to the base table API for applicable events, slots, and exposed members.

Full table instance and half-checked tree rows ​

getHalfSelectionRows() returns the half-checked rows from the current native tree selection column. In the example, select one child in an AsamTableColumn of type selection, then read the parent's half-checked state. Native tree-column selection and the cross-page selection enabled by selectable have separate state. getSelection, getSelectionRows, clearSelection, toggleRowSelection, and toggleAllSelection use this page's cross-page selection rules.

Failure and retry ​

error emits an AsamDataError and success emits an AsamPage<Row>. The component displays errors and stale data and restricts pagination and selection while stale. Call reload({ force: true }) to force a reload or cancel() to cancel the active request. Handle the success, error, or cancelled branch of the reload result by its status.

Cross-page selection, stale data recovery, and cancellation ​

The local API returns a strict { list, total } page. buildPageParams combines the query and pagination inputs, and rowKey derives stable row identifiers. Compare selection-change and getSelection() with getSelectionRows(), which returns the resolved rows. Native row-click, sort-change, and column slots keep their display semantics. sort() sorts the current native table display. A failed request retains the last successful page, page number, and total. Stale data blocks new selection and hides pagination until recovery. Calling cancel() settles the in-flight reload as cancelled. The toolbar receives the snapshot and loading and stale flags. The base table handles append and empty.

Cross-page selection, stale data recovery, and cancellation ​

The example records seven data events. update:currentPage, page-change, update:pageSize, and page-size-change emit numbers, and the page size toggles between 2 and 4. selection-change emits the cross-page key and row snapshot, success emits { list, total }, and error records the structured error kind and message. Native row and sort events have separate log entries.

Standalone pagination state and request lifecycle ​

Use useAsamPagedData(config) to share the same pagination protocol with a custom table. config.source accepts a configuration object, ref, computed value, or synchronous getter. Supply the request environment through an explicit runtime or call provideAsamData(app, provider). With immediate: false, the composable prepares the inputs and keys and waits for reload(). The equivalent TypeScript and JavaScript lifecycle examples exercise success, empty results, failure, cancellation, input changes, cross-page selection, caching, provider injection, and app unmount.

Standalone pagination state and request lifecycle ​

AsamApiPageSource<Q, P, R, T> declares the API, query, pagination builder, and transform. AsamPagedInput<Q, P, R, T> models the three valid source branches: API, URL with default merging, and URL with a custom builder. AsamPagedInputBase describes shared fields. Use AsamPagedInput for the complete configuration. AsamPage<T>.list and total and AsamTableSelection<T>.keys and rows are read-only. The number 1 and the string '1' are distinct row keys.

Standalone pagination state and request lifecycle ​

A zero total normalizes the page to 1. A page beyond the last page is corrected and requested once more. A second out-of-range response yields a response error. A query or source identity change cancels the old request, clears selection, and starts again at page 1. Equivalent wrappers and controlled value echoes preserve the active request. Scope or epoch invalidation cancels requests, clears data, the resolved page, and selection, and evicts the cache. After the owning scope unmounts, reload() resolves as cancelled.

Native presentation of the current page ​

The full example combines fixed headers and columns, two levels of grouped headers, column and header templates, row numbering, current-row highlighting, native sorting and filtering, expandable content, summaries, status styling, merged status cells, and overflow tooltips. sort(), clearSort(), clearFilter(), toggleRowExpansion(), and setCurrentRow() operate on the current native table. Events preserve the row type. Manage server queries and pagination separately. The local example merges adjacent cells from its first two of three rows. For dynamic grouping, sorting, and filtering, calculate spanMethod using the visible rows. The summary covers only the displayed rows.

Native presentation of the current page ​

The height controls demonstrate maxHeight=150 for a scroll area and height=310 with maxHeight=310 for a fixed height. The layout control toggles tableLayout between fixed and auto. The request count stays the same. Native 2.14.7 retains a previously set inline limit when maxHeight becomes undefined, so the example explicitly sets matching height and maximum values when restoring the fixed height. The native component uses fixed with a defined maxHeight, so the auto branch omits that prop.

Native presentation of the current page ​

The callback controls show text and VNode results for summaries and tooltips, array and object results for spanMethod, and string and generic function forms for rowClassName. Returning undefined from spanMethod restores native spans until the merge rule is enabled again. Toggle showSummary to hide and restore the summary. Heights accept numbers or CSS strings. With height omitted, maxHeight constrains the scroll area. The pinned native clearFilter() accepts no argument, a single key, or an array of keys. Omit the row from setCurrentRow() to clear highlighting. Omit the second argument to toggleRowExpansion() to toggle expansion. Passing a row retains its type. These operations work on the existing page. Server filtering and sorting require their own query updates.

Native tree loading and row keys ​

currentRowKey, expandRowKeys, and updateKeyChildren use the original rowKey result, so 1 and "1" identify different rows. To update the native lazy tree, enable lazy and pass a loaded parent key and new child rows to updateKeyChildren(). The page source stays the same. Replacing loaded children can refresh the selected row snapshots and remove selections for children that no longer exist. Remote and Dictionary Cascader and Tree Select use complete tree sources. Their data contract excludes per-node loading. Pass the current instance's row to setCurrentRow() and toggleRowExpansion(). The example uses normalized rows from success.list or column slots because API objects and instance rows may have different references.

Internal row key resolution ​

Configure rowKey with a field name or synchronous callback. The root's export type * makes the asamRowKey declaration available for type queries using import type and typeof. The runtime function is internal, and the package exposes no deep import for the internal paging module. The row key reader requires an own string or finite numeric value and rejects asynchronous and thenable results. Applications must still configure the correct rowKey.

Internal row key resolution ​

Expand the lifecycle example's pagination row-key section. It runs useAsamPagedData with an own empty-string key, zero, negative numbers, finite decimals, and synchronous callbacks returning strings or numbers. Boolean, null, object, missing, inherited, nonfinite, and duplicate keys produce a response error before publishing the page. The synchronous guard rejects promises and thenables regardless of settlement and handles rejected promises without leaking an unhandled rejection. toggleRowSelection() and selectPage() use the same guard for the current page. Invalid asynchronous keys leave selection unchanged, and restoring a synchronous callback enables selection again. In typed application code, follow the public synchronous rowKey signature.

Internal row key resolution ​

append and empty have no scope arguments. DataTable passes them through AsamTable to the native Table. append follows the body rows. empty appears when there are no displayable rows and takes priority over native empty text. Put columns directly in the default slot. AsamTableColumn supplies its own row scope.

Internal row key resolution ​

In pinned native 2.14.7, append precedes the summary in fixed layout and follows the in-body summary in auto layout. DataTable and the base table preserve that order through the public native slot. The lifecycle example covers both layouts, empty and populated member pages, failure while retaining rows, recovery to an empty page, and removing and restoring custom slots. A historical candidate's uniform ordering depended on an earlier private modification.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only while the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. The error is the same AsamDataError emitted by that instance, including cause, kind, message, and notified. Rendering the slot leaves the provider's notification state unchanged. stale indicates that the retained data is outdated.

Additional props and events ​

Standalone pagination state and request lifecycle ​

The instance controls call toggleRowSelection(row, true/false) on rows from success.list. Omit the second argument to toggle the row. toggleAllSelection() affects only the current loaded page. Use getSelection() for cross-page keys and rows and getSelectionRows() for resolved rows. While stale, the table blocks new selections and whole-page toggles. Deselect individual rows or call clearSelection() to clear selection across pages. New selection is available after recovery. cancel() cancels the request and preserves the visible successful page and selection. Handle the reload result's cancelled branch separately.

import type { AsamDataTableEmits, AsamTableSelection, AsamPage, AsamDataError, AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

	"update:currentPage": [value: number];
	"update:pageSize": [value: number];
	"page-change": [value: number];
	"page-size-change": [value: number];
	"selection-change": [selection: AsamTableSelection<T>];
	"success": [data: AsamPage<T>];
	"error": [error: AsamDataError];
	"select": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["select"];
	"select-all": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["select-all"];
	"cell-mouse-enter": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["cell-mouse-enter"];
	"cell-mouse-leave": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["cell-mouse-leave"];
	"cell-dblclick": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["cell-dblclick"];
	"cell-contextmenu": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["cell-contextmenu"];
	"cell-click": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["cell-click"];
	"row-dblclick": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["row-dblclick"];
	"row-click": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["row-click"];
	"row-contextmenu": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["row-contextmenu"];
	"header-click": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["header-click"];
	"header-contextmenu": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["header-contextmenu"];
	"sort-change": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["sort-change"];
	"filter-change": [filters: Record<string, string[]>];
	"current-change": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["current-change"];

	"expand-change": (AsamDataTableEmits<T>)["expand-change"];

};

AsamDataTableExpose public type definition
ts
import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, Attrs, ComponentInternalInstance, AppContext, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamRecord, AsamTableSelection, AsamRowKey, AsamPage, AsamReloadResult, AsamTableContext, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableFilter, AsamScrollbarDirection } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamDataTableExpose
type PublicContract<T extends object = AsamRecord> = {
	"clearSelection": () => void;
	"getSelection": () => AsamTableSelection<T>;
	"toggleRowSelection": (row: T, selected?: boolean) => void;
	"getSelectionRows": () => T[];
	"toggleAllSelection": () => void;
	"updateKeyChildren": (key: AsamRowKey, children: T[]) => void;
	readonly "reload": (options?: { readonly force?: boolean; }) => Promise<AsamReloadResult<AsamPage<T>>>;
	readonly "cancel": () => void;
	readonly "sort": (prop: string, order: string) => void;
	readonly "context": AsamTableContext<T>;
	readonly "tableLayout": "auto" | "fixed";
	readonly "allowDragLastColumn": boolean;
	readonly "ns": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["ns"];
	readonly "layout": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["layout"];
	readonly "store": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["store"];
	readonly "columns": AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	readonly "handleHeaderFooterMousewheel": (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number; }) => void;
	readonly "handleMouseLeave": () => void;
	readonly "tableId": string;
	readonly "tableSize": "" | "large" | "default" | "small";
	readonly "isHidden": boolean;
	readonly "isEmpty": boolean;
	readonly "renderExpanded": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["renderExpanded"];
	readonly "resizeProxyVisible": boolean;
	readonly "resizeState": { width: null | number; height: null | number; headerHeight: null | number; };
	readonly "isGroup": boolean;
	readonly "bodyWidth": string;
	readonly "tableBodyStyles": { width: string; };
	readonly "emptyBlockStyle": { width: string; height: string; } | undefined;
	readonly "debouncedUpdateLayout": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["debouncedUpdateLayout"];
	readonly "setCurrentRow": (row?: T | undefined) => void;
	readonly "getHalfSelectionRows": () => T[];
	readonly "clearFilter": (columnKeys?: string[] | string) => void;
	readonly "toggleRowExpansion": (row: T, expanded?: boolean) => void;
	readonly "clearSort": () => void;
	readonly "doLayout": () => void;
	readonly "t": AsamDataTableExpose<T>["t"];
	readonly "setDragVisible": (visible: boolean) => void;
	readonly "computedSumText": string;
	readonly "computedEmptyText": string;
	readonly "computedTooltipEffect": string | undefined;
	readonly "computedTooltipOptions": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["computedTooltipOptions"];
	readonly "scrollbarViewStyle": { display: string; verticalAlign: string; };
	readonly "scrollbarStyle": { height: string; maxHeight?: undefined; } | { maxHeight: string; height?: undefined; } | { height?: undefined; maxHeight?: undefined; };
	readonly "scrollBarRef": (AsamDataTableExpose<T>)["scrollBarRef"];
	readonly "scrollTo": (options: ScrollToOptions | number, yCoord?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollLeft": (left?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollTop": (top?: number) => void;
};
